title: Compact Immutable WOFOST Rate Table Substrate
goal: Implement the smallest source-bound immutable table substrate needed by the restricted standard-WOFOST rate provider, preserving SWAP 4.3.1 B1.10 AFGEN clamp and linear-interpolation semantics without carrying parser sentinel storage into the kernel.

legacy_semantics: x <= first knot clamps to first y
x >= last active knot clamps to last active y
legacy decreasing-x sentinel only marks the end of active data in fixed parser storage

API.storage_rule: tables are immutable parameter data intended to be shared by crop/template identity; they are never transaction state or worker scratch

fail_closed_rules: x/y sizes must match and contain at least one knot
all active x/y values must be finite
active x values must be strictly increasing
nonfinite query x is rejected before comparison/arithmetic
an unconstructed or invalid table cannot be evaluated
qualification_tests: compare compact table outputs against an exact local implementation of legacy AFGEN for a full legacy table
compare against a partially filled legacy table with a decreasing-x sentinel and unused tail
first/last clamp, exact knots and interior interpolation
reject empty, size-mismatched, duplicate-x, decreasing-x and nonfinite knot data
reject nonfinite query without floating-point exception under invalid traps
F-WOF28 rate-state view exact regression remains unchanged
forbidden: legacy fixed alternating x/y arrays as production storage
decreasing-x sentinel or unused tail in production table storage
WOFOST PGASS, maintenance, partitioning, death or leaf-growth equations
per-column duplication requirement for immutable tables
